\section{Retrieved magnetic filling factors}
\label{app:filling_factors}

Table~\ref{tab:ff_full} lists the complete set of magnetic filling factors
$f_i$ retrieved for the 41 stars of the sample, with their $1\sigma$
uncertainties. These are the per-bin values summarised as bar histograms in the
last column of the main results table (Table~\ref{tab:results}). The width of
each row's grid is set per star by the BIC-driven magnetic-component scan
(Sect.~\ref{sec:methods_filter}).
